title: Team
description: .agents/team.json: the AI tools the person selected for this project (TOOL-2, TEAM-1), each at the capability level it is set up with. Written only for the person's own selection.

members.description: Selected tools, at most one entry per tool id (checked in code). Empty when the person has selected none.

toolId.description: The id tool discovery gives this tool.

name.description: The name discovery found in the tool's own files (untrusted text, length capped).

capability.description: 3 = MCP, 2 = reads instruction files, 1 = chat only (handoff package).

confirmedByPerson.description: True when the person chose the level themselves because discovery could not tell (or found a lower one).

models.description: The models the person uses in this tool, as they typed them (TOOL-2, TOOL-6). Used to assign tasks to the best tool and model (D).
